subject: POC top-up vs term-blend — sprint option and amendment
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@starkretail.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC top-up vs term-blend — sprint option and amendment

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Based on what you described (heavy inference during nightly batch runs + some peak traffic during promos), I sketched two practical paths to extend the POC without slowing your delivery timeline:

1) Top-up: one-time credit bucket (tokens + 24/7 priority) that buys you 3 additional weeks of runtime at current rate.
2) Term-blend (sprint): 6-week amended term that includes a moderate commit and a smaller immediate top-up to cover the near-term burst.

Attached is a concise comparison (tabbed: costs, SLA, eng hours, conversion triggers) — pricing-topup-vs-term-blend.xlsx.

Quick asks:
- Which approach would be easier for Stark to sign from a procurement perspective (one PO vs amendment to existing SOW)?
- Do you need an explicit SLA uplift during the sprint weeks? We can scope a limited SLA for promo windows.

If you'd like, we can propose a blended counteroffer (small top-up + 2-week sprint) to bridge to term negotiations. Jordan / Marissa — looping you for pricing/legal readiness.

Thanks,
Kim
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-1212

Attachments: pricing-topup-vs-term-blend.xlsx

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@starkretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-26T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC top-up vs term-blend — sprint option and amendment

Kim —

Appreciate the clear options. A couple of clarifying points from our side:
- Procurement prefers a single short amendment (we avoid multiple POs for the same POC) but legal wants to see clear finish criteria.
- Can the top-up credits be restricted to the batch/ingest endpoints (we want to avoid accidental overrun on high-cost generation flows)?

Practically, I'd be comfortable with a 2-week sprint + top-up to cover the next major promo if we can get a 48-hour turnaround on paperwork. CC'ing contracts@starkretail.com to flag the timeline.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of AI Platforms, Stark Retail
liam.oconnor@starkretail.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-27T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC top-up vs term-blend — sprint option and amendment

Kim / Marissa —

Thanks for the note — I ran the numbers and recommend a blended commercial that should be easy for procurement and low-friction for Stark's legal. Key points:
- Offer: 2-week sprint (SLA uplift for promos) + $25k token top-up restricted by endpoint tag (we can gate by API key + route).
- Discount: 12% off hosted-rate on the sprint weeks if Stark commits to a 6-week follow-on evaluation conversion window (simple opt-in).
- Engineering hours: include up to 12 eng-hours for integration + one priority on-call day during the promo.

I've uploaded a pricing worksheet to the thread (pricing-topup-vs-term-blend.xlsx) with a 'blended' tab showing the net NPV vs pure top-up or pure term. If legal is OK with the gated-credit mechanism we can draft a short amendment that includes the opt-in window.

Deal: DEAL-9831. I also added a quick HubSpot link for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9831

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Sr. Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@starkretail.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, contracts@starkretail.com
Date: 2026-10-28T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC top-up vs term-blend — sprint option and amendment

Liam —

Appreciate the procurement constraints. We can do the single-amendment flow. Draft summary below (I'll attach a one-page amendment and send for DocuSign if you confirm):

- Scope: 2-week sprint starting on execution date + $25k restricted credit bucket for batch endpoints only.
- SLA uplift: 99.5% for promo windows (2x incident priority).
- Engineering: up to 12 hours of Eng support, plus one priority day during the promo launch.
- Conversion window: 6 weeks post-sprint to convert to a committed Dedicated or continue on ratecard with a 12% sprint discount applied to the sprint weeks.

Notes: the restricted-credit gating will be enforced by a route label and API key; we'll work with your infra team to verify. If Stark signs the amendment within 48 hours we can guarantee sprint-ready status before the promo.

I'm attaching the draft amendment: amendment-draft.pdf. If that looks good, we can send DocuSign for signature and include a billing note that charges the top-up at execution.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: amendment-draft.pdf
